title: 34-year-old man shot, killed in Hopewell - NewsBreak
text:
By Clare Gehlich ,
13 hours ago HOPEWELL, Va. (WRIC) — A 34-year-old man was shot and killed in Hopewell late Wednesday night, and authorities have launched a homicide investigation.
At around 10:23 p.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 7, Hopewell Telecommunications received a report of a shooting in the 700 block of Arlington Road in Hopewell, where they found 34-year-old Vernon Browder of Hopewell with a gunshot wound. He died at the scene, according to police.
The Hopewell Police Department launched a homicide investigation and currently believes this was an isolated incident.
Further details were not made immediately available as of the time of reporting.
There is no ongoing threat to the public, but officials continue to investigate.
Anyone with information is asked to contact Lead Detective Spencer Rotzoll of the Hopewell Criminal Investigations Unit at 804-541-2284 or the Hopewell Prince George Crime Solvers hotline at 804-541-2202 .
